title: 1951 AHSME Problem 4
statement: A barn with a flat roof is rectangular in shape, \(10\) yd. wide, \(13\) yd. long, and \(5\) yd. high. It is to be painted inside and outside, and on the ceiling, but not on the roof or floor. The total number of square yards to be painted is:

solutions.text:
The four walls have one-sided area \[ 2(13\cdot5)+2(10\cdot5)=230. \] Painting them inside and outside contributes \(2(230)=460.\) The ceiling adds \(10\cdot13=130,\) so the total is \(460+130=590.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Count both the inside and outside faces of each of the four walls
